Best friends Sharon and Michelle realise they have neglected their friendship of late. They decide it's high time they had a girls' night out. Is there a happy event anticipated in Albert Square?
Will Michelle finally discover the reason why Arthur has been avoiding Mark? Grant lets jealousy rear its ugly head.
Ricky has a surprise for Sam which further irritates Frank, while Clyde shocks his father. Arthur gets a gardening contract.
Etta and Celestine are planning a family party, but the younger Traverniers are reluctant to attend. Ian is pleased that Hattie is paying him more attention.
Arthur becomes the hero of the day. Hattie tries to avoid Ian, while Sharon isn't impressed with the company Grant is keeping. Ricky decides to sell his van to raise money.

Grant finds out who his real friends are. Arthur wants to patch things up with Mark - can Pauline persuade the stubborn pair to make amends? Pat has some wise words for Sam and Ricky about their responsibilities.
Phil finds romance on his night out with the boys.
All Arthur wants is to give his wife a special birthday treat - what could be simpler?
Phil plans the perfect date, but is his idea of a romantic evening the same as Anne's? Gill gives Mark some advice about Arthur.
Anne's got a surprise for Phil - but Pat gets the biggest shock.
Pat plays surrogate mother to Mandy. Will Frank play the father role?
Mark makes a decision about his future which proves unpopular with Pauline. Could Gill be the one to change his mind? Sam and Ricky are in for a shock at the squat.
On Mother's Day, Etta is concerned about Lloyd's friends, while Sharon worries about the decrease in takings at the pub.
Anne wants the chance to explain her situation to Phil, but after the hurt she has caused him, will he listen? Ignoring his family's advice, Lloyd goes looking for adventure.
When a builder's estimate makes Frank see red, he decides to attempt some DIY.
Pat is shocked when she finds out that Mandy has being lying to her.
Arthur spreads spring fever around the Square. But Pat has problems and memories to share.

It is a special day for Gill, but her plans unsettle Mark. Dot wants to share her news as Easter approaches. But will the holiday spirit affect Ian and Steve? Pete believes he has the answer to Arthur's problems.
The Miss Queen Vic's beauty contest takes a surprising turn.

The world of glitz and glamour is beckoning to Sam but will husband Ricky allow it? The Taverniers await an important decision on Lloyd's future. And Dot has a bee in her bonnet, but is she fighting a lost cause?
Frank and Pat move out of the B and B. Arthur practices his interviewing technique.

Sam takes the first steps towards an exciting career. Arthur introduces his new assistant to the gardening trade. Gill gives Pauline some tactful advice about Mark. And Michelle has an idea on how Rachel can raise some extra money, but will Rachel agree?
Tempers are running high at the Tavernier's, while Rachel awaits important news about her future.

Michelle, Clyde and Pat believe their jobs at the Queen Vic are under threat. Sharon, however, is preoccupied with more personal matters and keeps Grant guessing. Meanwhile, Rachel reluctantly prepares for another stint at the cafe, Frank's troubles are doubled, and Ethel tests Dot's patience.
Celestine tries to reassure Etta about Lloyd, and Sharon is upset about Grant making plans about the future without consulting her.
Ethel is forced to make a difficult decision, one that has serious consequences for a very close friend.
Ian entertains an important business client and his wife, but who will he find to be his dinner date? Frank finally gets the keys to the Butchers' new home, but first Pat sets him a daunting task.
Dot's in for a surprise when a stranger calls.
There are difficult decisions to be made for the Taverniers.
A life and death decision cause discord at the Fowlers.
Ricky is curious about Sam's secretive behaviour. Dot is worried about the future of the launderette.
Gill fears that Mark will not be able to cope with the difficult times ahead.
Kathy's back but Ian doesn't want to talk.
A brother's loyalty is put to the test.
The secret's out and Sam gets some unwelcome exposure.
Sam fears her marriage may be on the rocks. Gill is forced to make a harrowing decision.
AIDS-sufferer Gill is dying, so she and Mark throw away their sadness and prepare to marry.
Mark faces up to a great test of his personal strength.
Mandy's back. She's looking for a job, a home and a man.
Pete's caught with his trousers down. Hattie feels that Steve's mind should be turned to more romantic matters.
Romance is in the air for Ricky but Sam is looking elsewhere.
Pat is determined not to let Frank stand in the way of her independence - but Ricky pays the price. Michelle is on tenterhooks as she awaits the results of her first year exams.
Mark is in for a shock.
A day at the races, but Arthur's not invited.

Rachel and Kathy brave the local jumble sale in search of marketable goods. Mandy makes an effort to befriend Mark in the hope of staying at the squat for good. Meanwhile, Pat employs her first driver - but is Dennis exactly the man PatCabs needs?

Pat pays the price of Dennis's shortcomings. Kathy and Rachel have an unexpected run-in with the new Market Inspector which makes a poor start to Rachel's new career. Arthur has a problem when Norman the Gnome goes missing.
Michelle's life and loves are forging ahead. Surely nothing can spoil her day?
Two birthdays in the Fowler family. Pete is the life and soul of Martin's party, but will an unwelcome guest ruin Michelle's?

Mandy works on Pete to get a job, and Dot makes a discovery that shocks her. Frank thinks he has found the solution to his problems with PatCabs. Grant disappears, leaving Phil and Sharon alone in the Vic to face an uninvited midnight visitor.

Dot gets more than she bargained for when she tries to talk to Mark about Arthur's "friendship" with Mrs. Hewitt. Rachel puts a spanner in Frank's plan to relocate PatCabs. Meanwhile, Sharon and Phil are left alone in the Vic but where is Grant?
Pete discovers the real cost of employing Mandy. Rachel is shocked by the hostile reaction from her fellow stallholders.
There is a surprise when Ian fails to return to the Square, Mark takes Mandy in hand, Kathy sorts out Rachel's problems with Tricky Dicky, and Mrs Hewitt has a surprise for Arthur.
Ian's new image doesn't get the reaction he expects. Mandy takes Sam on a shopping trip with a difference. And a mugging in broad daylight shocks the Square.
Dot arranges to nurse Jules, Rachel learns there is money in junk, Steve finds his enterprise shot down by Ian and a letter for Arthur leads to a final goodbye. Sam is nervous about her interview.

Deciding that it's time to introduce his new girlfriend to his parents, Ian invites them all to a dinner party. Dot helps Jules recover from his mugging. And, just when she thought she was getting the hang of market life, Rachel's conscience is tested by an awkward encounter with a dissatisfied customer.

Ricky learns that he has passed his exams; but will the Mitchell brothers give him a rise? Ian and Ronnie can't see enough of each other and Kathy is worried that things are moving too fast. Michelle is concerned about Sharon and has a sudden suspicion as to what the problem might be.
Tricky Dicky helps Rachel acquire new stock but Kathy suspects his motives. And things go from bad to worse between Grant and Sharon.
The pressures in the Queen Vic on Grant, Sharon and Phil have finally come to a head. But where do they go from here?
Mark finds himself unable to deal with Gill's death. And Mandy makes a discovery while looking through Gill's things.

Dot and Ethel have an afternoon out at a tea-dance to mark Ethel's wedding anniversary, and enjoy a brief encounter with the mysterious Major Grace. Mark seeks advice from his father on how to cope with his grief, but Mandy offers a more instant solution. Kathy learns not to rely on Nigel.
Unwelcome visitors at the Meal Machine cause problems for Ian. Grant suspects Phil is in love. And Sharon struggles to make a decision.
Sharon seeks medical help. Nigel moves house. Ian tries to save his business, and Rachel has an unexpected visitor.
Cockroaches at the Meal Machine threaten Ian's success. Rachel's patience is tested by her mother's surprise visit. And Pauline comes home to find her family gone.
Arthur and Pauline are finaly united in Leigh-on-Sea, but has their marriage survived the long separation. Rachel's mother continues to meddle in her life.
Ian seeks a desperate solution to his cashflow problems. A man from the council has bad news for the squatters, and Rachel has to face up to her mother and her past.
Tricky Dicky has a surprise for Rachel, and Sharon plans a controversial evening of entertainment. Early morning visitors at the squat cause a commotion in Albert Square.
Good news for Ian means the cold shoulder for Ronnie. Ricky faces a domestic crisis. Dot is horrified when her lodger Nigel has a brush with the law.

Mandy decides that Nigel is the answer to her housing problems. Ronnie's night out with Ian has a disappointing conclusion. The women in the Vic are entertained by 'Muscle in Motion'. Grant is not the only one who objects to women-only entertainment.
Arthur is hurt when he asks Mark for help, Grant's criminal friends turn up at the Vic with bad news, and Ian sees a face from the past.
Phil finds out about Grant's financial problems.
A surprise is planned for Sharon's birthday, Pat and Frank try a job swap and a visitor for Grant spells trouble.
Pauline hears some home truths from Arthur, Ian meets an old flame and Sharon's party goes with a bang.
Tricky Dicky's friendship with Rachel takes an unexpected turn and Kathy gets an unwanted guest. Meanwhile, a disaster at the pub shocks Albert Square.
Phil learns that Grant's desperate measures may not have solved their problem. Can the Queen Vic remain in business? Rachel confides in Michelle her true feelings for Richard.
Mandy finds the videotape that could destroy a marriage. Phil's got some bad news and sparks fly between Kathy and Pauline.
Ian has a surprise for Cindy, Pauline gets advice from an unexpected source and Phil tracks down a missing person.
Michelle suggests a girls' night out with Sharon at her college, but the evening ends in disaster when Grant and Clyde turn up.
Clyde hears some unpleasant home truths from Michelle and a confession rocks Sharon and Grant's marriage.
Arthur gets a mysterious package. Ian visits Cindy but fails to uncover her secret and Mandy sees a new side to Tricky Dicky.
Mark faces up to his grief. Ian has a confession to make. And Pauline makes an awful discovery.
Nigel tries to step into Steve's shoes, Dot finds a new recruit for her carol singers, and the new-look Queen Vic opens its doors for the first time since the fire.
Pauline confronts her nemesis - Mrs Hewitt. Mark finds out the truth between Michelle and Clyde, Dot has a disappointment and Steve makes a peace offering to Hattie.
Frank has a surprise bargain for Nigel, Grant has some bad news for Sharon, and Ian discovers the truth about Cindy.

Phil is put on the spot over the future of the Vic - where do his loyalties lie? Nigel has his revenge on Frank, but it is Dot who cleans up. Cindy has to make a decision and Arthur turns to an old friend.
As Arthur renews an old friendship, Ian gets an early dose of Christmas generosity and Nigel helps Dot secure a pianist for her carol rehearsals.

Dot sees a new side to Donald, her piano-player, when the carol practice is held at the pub, and Ian lays on a special "picnic" for Cindy. Kathy gets the distinct impression that everyone has been giving her the cold shoulder, but what will her reaction be when she finds out what Mandy has been saying about her?

Albert Square is making plans for Christmas. Hattie invites Steve to spend the holiday with her family and Mark starts looking for somewhere new to live. Ian makes Cindy an offer she can't refuse and Pat has a run-in with Father Christmas.
Mandy gets a new home, Pete gets an award at the market traders Christmas Ball; and Tricky Dicky wins a prize and asks Kathy to share it with him.
Ian helps Kathy to make her mind up and Mrs Hewitt gives Arthur an ultimatum. Grant threatens to explode - can Phil manage to defuse the situation?
Mandy expects a visit from her mother; the regulars at the Vic are entertained by the mysterious Arlene; Arthur comes to a decision and Pat gets a shock.
It's Christmas Day in Walford, and Michelle has an unexpected visitor. Pat and Frank have a difficult day and Mandy learns a lesson about home.

Ricky dreams of a fresh start for his marriage but Sam has a surprise for him. Frank does his best to help Pat, but things are not made any easier by Dot's continued gossip. Michelle notices that Pauline is suffering from post-Christmas blues and decides to give her a treat, while Sharon is delighted by Phil's continued support, and Arthur makes a mistake.

Hattie makes a bold move, Cindy makes a decision about her future and Ricky helps his father cope with a shock. At the Queen Vic, Nigel steps into the breach to provide the evening's entertainment when Sharon is let down at the last minute.
Tricky Dicky takes on Ian. Pete sees a face from the past and Steve gives Hattie an answer.
Pat hides as news of the accident spreads. Sam plans a weekend away, but is it work or pleasure? And Pauline meets an old schoolfriend who makes a big impression on Pete.
Public opinion adds to the pressures on Pat.
Sam's new friend Clive pushes his luck and visits the Vic. Kathy takes positive action to deal with a recurring problem from the past. And the trial of Nick Cotton finally begins.
Nick Cotton watches as the prosecution case is made and Dot faces Eddie's father. Meanwhile Ian has a confession to make to Kathy.
Phil is concerned about the state of Sam's marriage, Arthur spots some football talent at Walford Town and the trial of Nick Cotton reaches a climax.
The Fowlers get a new lodger, Pete gets a pleasant surprise and Dot makes a sad decision.
Nigel has problems at the launderette. Ricky makes a last effort to save his marriage. There are problems for the Fowlers, and Pete Beale has a pleasant surprise.
Ricky makes a last effort to save his marriage and Sam comes to a decision. Frank tries to help Pat face going to court and Rachel gets fed up with market life.
Michelle is put out when Rachel helps Jack with his college work. Ricky is forced to accept Sam's plans for the future, and Pat has an unexpected visitor.
Arthur's guilt over the lies he is telling comes to a head, Pete finds out the truth about Rose's absent husband and has to make a brave decision. An old friend of Tricky Dicky's turns up.
Arthur makes a mistake, a new trader appears on the market - to Rachel's disgust - and Mandy's evening in with Aidan has an unexpected conclusion.
Michelle is horrified to find Jack making friends with Pauline; Kathy's bistro runs into a few opening night problems; and a friendly poker game turns serious for Sanjay and Nigel.

Will straight talk from an old adversary make Pat realise that time will heal her anguish? Pauline's patience is tested by a house full of football fans; Sanjay has some explaining to do when his wife Gita arrives sooner than expected; and Rose is told to drop Pete before someone gets hurt.
Frank discovers that the cab company may not have a future. Gita is furious when she discovers that Sanjay has been gambling; and Pete and Rose have some unwanted visitors.
Clyde finds himself in dispute with the Mitchell brothers over the running of the pub, Rose makes a decision about her future with Pete, and Mandy goes to new lengths in her pursuit of Aidan.
Rachel hears some good news; Arthur gets into trouble with an unexpected bill: and Michelle has a late-night encounter.
Rose brings unexpected news of husband Alfie, Clyde tries to contact Sharon, Michelle gets a shock and Rachel finds it does not take long for her good news to spread round the Square.
The Fowler's world turns upside down - but where is Arthur?
As the hours tick by, Michelle's agony continues. How much longer will it be before Vicki is found? Meanwhile, her college friend Jack is furious when he faces questions.
Michelle struggles to rebuild her life; Sharon's return to the Vic has an unexpected conclusion.

Tricky Dicky gets involved in family matters and finds he's out of his depth. Michelle's emotions are put to the test again. As Sanjay goes flat-hunting, Richard does his best to keep Gita company, but things do not go smoothly.
Michelle confronts Sharon about life with Grant, and Sanjay sorts out his priorities, while Ian turns detective.
Grant reaches boiling point with Sharon and comes face to face with the consequences. Pete's hopes are shattered as Rose lays down her plans for the future.
Cindy's back and Dot tells everyone. Sharon is torn over Grant's arrest. Clyde decides to work for Frank, and Michelle has something Nigel wants.

Kathy gets a new assistant in the café, while Michelle has a narrow escape from an undesirable lodger. Kathy and Pat have to learn to accept Ian's new "family". At the Vic, it looks like Sharon may have got what she wanted - but what does she want?
Michelle's new lodger settles in, Pete gives Arthur some good news and Aidan's team trial has an unexpected outcome.
Sanjay and Gita invite Richard for a meal. Pauline and Arthur have a surprise encounter in the Bistro. Mandy finds Aidan in a positive frame of mind after his setback.

Aidan reaches a decision on his football career and Ricky fancies a job change. Michelle gets unwanted attention, while Hattie tries to celebrate her 18th birthday - but Steve has other things on his mind.

Hattie gets a belated surprise. Arthur gives Aidan a pep talk. Steve and Mark's venture takes off. Michelle gives Jack another warning. With her friends' help can she finally get through to him that she is not interested?

Preparations continue for a rave in Albert Square but problems along the way mean even Nigel is roped in to help. An alternative gig in the Vic ignites an old flame for Pauline while Arthur confides his work worries to Christine.
Jack's back but Sharon is in no position to advise Michelle as domestic bliss at the Vic is becoming strained, and Ricky attempts to run the Butcher empire single handed.
Shelley persuades Michelle to take matters into her own hands. Nigel gets a shock when he visits an old friend, and Danny is determined to show Pauline a good time.
Michelle turns the tables on Jack for the last time. Grant gets an unexpected visitor and Sharon has to face the consequences of deceiving Phil.
Tricky Dicky is caught redhanded, and Pat prepares herself for her court case.
Pauline has a showdown with Mandy over Aidan and Frank tries to help Pat face going to Court. Arthur has to make a difficult phone call while Sharon has to accept Phil's plans.
Pat is sent to prison, while Grant is released. Rose decides she can't live without Pete.

Alfie's family become a genuine threat and Pete takes the only course of action open to him. Phil and Grant discuss the future, Sharon and the Vic. Arthur and Mrs. Hewitt have a close shave. The burger war comes to an end.
An unexpected visitor arrives at the Taverniers, Danny buys Pauline a present and Arthur helps Aidan come to a decision about his future.
Cindy gets friendly with Tricky Dicky and hears what Gita thinks of him, Sharon tries to adjust to having Grant around and Mark helps Mandy out.
Gita gives Ian some advice, and Grant and Phil rescue Nigel from his birthday blues. Jules makes a confession to Dot, and Michelle is suspicious of a blossoming new friendship.
There is some unexpected news at the Taverniers.
Pauline has to respond to Danny's offer, but Arthur is more concerned with his interview. Richard gains the upper hand in his dirty tricks campaign against Ian. And Clyde learns more about Gidea.
Hattie's worst fears about Gidea seem to be realised.
Christine has to choose between Greg and Arthur. Michelle helps Clyde come to a decision. Nigel bumps into an old friend and Ian's behaviour is beginning to worry Cindy.
It's a bad day for Ian, Hattie and Steve. Clyde takes matters into his own hands. Nigel faces a disappointment. Meanwhile, Greg sees something he should not have.
Arthur has an unexpected visitor and Phil discovers a new drinking partner. Frank gets a hot tip and Hattie is forced to accept Ian's plans for the future.
Nigel has a dream date. Frank is out of his depth. And Greg Hewitt has news for Arthur and Christine. Good news?
Mandy is looking for another sucker, Jules tries to pour oil on troubled waters, Sharon's future is uncertain and Shelley has set her heart on Mark.

Dr. Legg becomes the latest in a long line of suckers. Mark's memories get in Shelley's way. Dot interferes with Nigel's love life. Grant is surprised at Phil's luke-warm reaction to his good news, while Hattie notices that Steve is becoming increasingly tetchy - is it just pre-wedding nerves?
Hattie has to face up to reality while Steve runs away. Phil stands by her and makes a new friend from a different world.

Hattie turns the tables on Steve but Clyde discovers there's something she hasn't told him. Clyde and Hattie are reconciled but a surprise visit makes things worse. Sharon is hostile when Phil brings a friend to the Vic.
There is tension in the Tavernier household as two secrets are unveiled, Michelle and Hattie have a heart to heart and Phil asks a favour from Clyde and Nigel.
It's a big day for Phil and Nadia, Kathy forces Mrs. Hewitt into a confession, Gidea gives Clyde an answer and Nigel and Debbie clear the air.
Nigel plans a special evening and Arthur keeps a low profile. Mark reaches boiling point and Clyde is forced to accept Gidea's plans for the future.
Sanjay takes some advice from Richard, and Mark is concerned about Aidan and Mandy. Gidea and Hattie share a problem.
Pauline wonders what's happened to Pete. The Kapoors' family loyalties are strained and Cindy is irritated by Ian's support of Hattie. Tricky Dicky takes advantage.

Shelley is ready to be more than just friends with Mark... if only they could get a moment alone. Pauline gets to the bottom of Pete's disappearance. Clyde and Gidea tie up loose ends and Gita warns Cindy about Richard.

Phil has a surprise for Mandy and Aidan, Cindy makes a date, Pauline explains her worries to Kathy and Dot gets a shock when a visitor arrives bringing news of Nick - but will she be willing to listen this time?
Tensions in the Kapoor household come to a head.
Ricky tries Frank's patience and Dot learns more about Nick's past. Aidan is offered the chance of a better life. But will he take it?
Tricky Dicky gets an unwelcome surprise. Nigel receives some bad news.

Mandy and Aidan discover they are not as streetwise as they would like to imagine. Richard and Cindy are telling different stories about their involvement. Shelley and her college friends turn out to be unsuitable babysitters.

Michelle and Sharon's past comes back to haunt them. Nigel wallows in self-pity but fails to arouse any sympathy. Dot's grandson begins to fall from grace. Gita does battle with Tricky Dicky - but who will come off worse?
Mandy has money to spend, but where is she getting it from? Phil and Nigel make an unusual purchase, and Cindy has a surprise in store for Ian.
Tensions between Hattie and Cindy come to a head with Ian caught in the middle. Arthur gets more surprises than he bargained for on his birthday.
Zoe has a startling proposition for Dot, and Pat is released from prison, but how will she react to her new freedom?
As Pauline and Arthur are drawn closer together, Christine becomes more desperate.
Mrs. Hewitt continues to put pressure on Arthur while a trip to France gives Frank the opportunity to practise his non-existent French. And romance is in the air for both the Mitchell brothers.
Frank has to face another family crisis. Pat is supportive but stubbornness seems to run in the family. Grant and Sharon resolve their differences. Meanwhile Phil and Kathy discuss past loves.
A surprise visit for Nick can only mean more trouble for Nigel. Mrs Hewitt presents Arthur with an ultimatum.

Phil hears about Tricky Dicky's latest exploits and is determined to have it out with him. There's a painful and emotional showdown at the Fowlers'. Is divorce the only answer for Arthur and Pauline or can he win her round?
Michelle and Mark struggle to pick up the pieces when they hear of their parents' trouble and Arthur tries to do the decent thing. Sanjay comes up with a plan to make money and Nigel moves house.
Kathy tries to make her peace with Pauline, Mrs. Hewitt has an unexpected visitor and Mandy is forced to come clean.
Nigel and Sanjay play musical dogs. Pauline holds her ground while Arthur's life falls apart.

Arthur neglects his work to play hero, but Pauline is not taken in. Aidan has big plans but Mandy does not share his enthusiasm for work. When temptation is put in her way will she prove that old habits die hard? Cindy is taken aback when Hattie renegotiates her status at work. Meena causes tension between her sister, Gita, and Sanjay.
Arthur's attempts to console Christine get him into trouble, Sanjay's hopes of a windfall are dashed and Nigel has some visitors from the past.
Nigel has another traumatic meeting and Tricky Dicky makes a startling claim.
There's a shock for Pauline when she overhears some gossip.
Ian confronts Kathy about vicious rumours, but finds the truth hard to take. Mrs. Hewitt tries to find Arthur but runs foul of Mark. Nigel looks set to play happy families at last.
Nigel's gone missing, but only Phil seems to care. Meanwhile, he and Sanjay have to decide what to do with the dogs. There's a new addition at the Butchers' and it's not good news for Ricky.
Ricky has an idea to help the homeless, but it backfires on him when Frank decides to do some DIY. Meena seeds Gita's suspicions about Sanjay's wanderings. Pat resumes her role as surrogate mother.
Ricky feels let down and and Tricky Dicky's flirtation with Shelley becomes more intense.
It's Sharon's birthday but no one is in the mood to celebrate. Michelle puts Richard in his place, tension between Ian and Cindy reaches a head and Frank is losing his patience with Janine.
Cindy is still worried about Tricky Dicky's rumour mongering, and when he winds her up in the Vic she finds no one willing to come to her defence.

Ricky is put in charge of organising Janine's party - is disaster inevitable? Ian is furious with Kathy for attacking Cindy and drags up a nasty secret from her past in front of Phil. Michelle has a confession to make to Pauline.
Kathy's business plans conflict with Ian's. Mandy and Aidan are up to their tricks.
Michelle faces a setback in her holiday plans. Phil's past catches up with him. Frank's under pressure but is it really Ricky's fault?
The Butcher's find that a new house doesn't necessarily mean a better way of life. Mark has a surprise present for Michelle; and a Home Office official has some awkward questions for Phil.
Frank's feud with the rival cab firm hots up. Aidan receives some news and Shelley finds herself looking forward to her trip to Amsterdam.
Mark, Michelle, Clem and Shelley set off for their weekend away. Michelle gets some unwelcome attention while Shelley gets a shock. In the Square, Gita's suspicions are aroused again.
Tensions flare up in Amsterdam as relationships are put to the test, and Michelle and Shelley come home with more than they bargained for.
Michelle and Shelley are back from Amsterdam but what has happened to Mark and Clem?
Ricky discovers the truth behind Janine's unhappiness and takes matters into his own hands, while Frank plots his revenge.
Ian is struggling - will Cindy swallow her pride and ask Kathy for help? Meanwhile Ricky's got a more serious problem - with the police.
Tricky Dicky's in trouble on the market - will he give Big Ron's stall back? Pauline's hopes of finding Pete are renewed. Dr. Legg drops another bombshell on Mandy and Aidan.
As the Square prepares for Christmas, Tricky Dicky faces up to discontent among the stall-holders and Gita's resolve begins to crumble.
While preparations get under way at the Vic for a homecoming, Frank comes to a decision about the cab company and Ian has some good news for Kathy.
Ian steps in to help Arthur and Pauline. Pat discovers Frank has gone behind her back.

Pat decides to take matters into her own hands and Frank is, naturally, less than pleased. Phil and Kathy agree to spend Christmas away together, but a surprise visit from someone scuppers their plans.
The Fowlers pull together over the arrangements for Pete's funeral.

Aidan's troubles seem to be getting to him. Nadia attempts to get Phil's attention. Frank doesn't appreciate Pat's attempts to solve their financial problems. Pete is laid to rest, but it seems not everyone wants it that way.
The Fowlers are determined not to rise to the Chapman's bait. Phil is late for Kathy's party, and Mandy and Aidan are left out in the cold.

It's the day after Christmas but for some the festive spirit is thin on the ground. Away from the Square, Mandy and Aidan are forced to face the truth. Gita has some news for Sanjay and Phil is increasingly troubled about Nadia.
In the aftermath of Christmas, Phil finds it hard to keep Kathy and Nadia apart. Sanjay finds himself looking for a babysitter and Pauline has some news.
Tricky Dicky finds himself in big trouble at the market.

Gita is devastated by what she has seen, and has important decisions to make. Michelle has a surprise announcement. Phil has a proposition for Frank, and when Nadia turns up yet again in the Vic, Grant decides to take matters into his own hands.
Pat receives a visitor she never expected to see. Pauline receives word of a distant relative in need.
Gita takes over the stall and Tricky Dicky has to pay for his interference. Kathy feels left out of Ian's life.
The Fowlers prepare for a new arrival. Richard, meanwhile, has some good news for Bianca, and Cindy is worried Ian is working too hard.
There is consternation when an old face returns to the Albert Square. Meanwhile, Debbie has some worrying news for Nigel and Arthur finds his kindness being abused.
Gita and Meena have a tense family reunion. Phil becomes suspicious of Ian in the café.
Frank takes pity on David. Meanwhile, Nellie reveals her true colours at Baby Peter's homecoming party.
Michelle has some news for Sanjay about Gita. Nigel continues his hospital visits.
While Cindy gives Kathy a piece of her mind, Pat steps in as the perfect granny.
Arthur develops an interest in Nellie's mail. Ian discovers that Richard has made a new friend.
Nellie has some news for Arthur, and Frank has to bow to some financial pressure.
Things look bad for Michelle until Auntie Nellie steps in, while Mark comes up against Ian's greed.
Mark isn't happy when Michelle interferes in his life.
Bianca finds out that Richard is not easily fooled.
Mark comes up against Ian's greed when he puts a business proposal to him. Bianca and Natalie get revenge on Richard. Steve gets his comeuppance when an old score is settled in Norwich.
Richard finds himself at the centre of an escalating nuisance campaign, and Cindy decides to hold a surprise birthday party for Ian.
Nigel sets about looking for a job. David is pleased to receive a visit from the police, and the financial noose tightens around Frank's neck.
Phil is under pressure to keep a promise, and Frank's plans don't go according to plan.
Phil receives some devastating news from Kathy, and Frank faces up to an unpleasant reality. Shelley, unfortunately, gets caught up in a Fowler feud, and Mark discovers he has a fairy godmother.
Richard decides to seek out his secret admirer while Cindy is confused by Ian's behaviour.
Grant and Phil have a word of warning for Richard while Ian has a surprise for Cindy.
Shelley thinks that a holiday might help her relationship, but Mark has other ideas. Arthur is having car trouble and Grant gets an unexpected visitor.
A ghost from Kathy's past returns to haunt her.
Kathy makes a decision which changes her life, while Ricky leaves Frank speechless when he describes his new job.
Phil follows the trail of a secret obsession, and Grant decides to go for gold. Bianca and Natalie run rings around Richard, and Alan arrives just in time to put the icing on the cake.
Robbie goes off the rails in the Square, while Sharon is convinced that Grant and Dougie are up to no good.

Frank has not been altogether honest with his family about the state of his accounts, so when a loss adjuster from the insurance company comes to check the books, poor old Pat does her best to help them in their enquiries. Frank has only one option left: he goes out for a long walk.

Tension at the Queen Vic is mounting as Grant discovers that Dougie has altered the arrangements for their planned supermarket robbery and he has serious doubts about his involvement. Sharon is also increasing the pressure on Grant. Meanwhile Phil's attempts at helping Kathy to come to terms with the past only infuriate her.
Sharon and Michelle want an early night, but the unpredictable Dougie has other plans.
Both Michelle and Sharon are in an emotional state after the events of last night. Phil and Grant have some unfinished business to sort out.
Phil steps in to give Grant a hand at the Vic, but the brothers are in for a stressful day and Carol wants to settle the differences between her and Pat.
Debbie gets worrying news from her ex-husband's solicitor.
It's a big day for Steve, but things don't turn out quite as he'd planned. Phil finds himself in a new line of business.
Michelle returns from hospital to a nasty surprise, Carol and Alan realise that Sonia's birthday may be anything but happy. Sanjay find an unexpected visitor in his flat.
Nigel finds out there's a thief about and Carol has problems with a criminal closer to home.

Liam Tyler is still hanging around the neighbourhood trying to annoy Nigel Bates. Jimmy Coogan returns to The Arches to collect the ringed car but as Phil has not been paid, he wont give Jimmy the car.
The spirit of Frank Butcher lives on in Ricky, and Gita sees her boss in a new light.
Phil loses his rag, while Grant loses his motor, and Gita pays Ian back in more ways than one.
Police visit Pat with unexpected news about Frank, and Phil's enemies decide Kathy is a favoured target.
Sanjay feels the pressure when Meena returns to the Square.
Phil is planning a tactical revenge on Jimmy, and Ricky's job brings him far too close to home. Meanwhile, David finds a safe bet and Mark has some brotherly advice for Michelle.
Grant is eager to get his hands on Jimmy, but Phil has a better plan of revenge. Michelle sits her first exam at college. Pat prepares to take on Mike's insurance company.
Kathy leaves Natalie and Bianca in charge of the cafe.
Alan wants to take more responsibility for his grandmother, but Carol isn't too happy about it.
An inquest delivers its verdict on the cause of Pete Beale's death, but Ian remains suspicious. Meanwhile Michelle is planning a romantic evening.
Ricky is missing Frank and decides to take matters into his own hands.
Ricky and Janine head back to Albert Square. Pat is worried sick about them but David is unsympathetic. Sharon lends her shoulder to cry on.
Michelle learns about age concern and Gita calls Sanjay to account.
Arthur refuses to help the aged.
Ricky gets his comeuppance, while Steve loses his dignity.
Money is missing from the Vic till and Sharon has a good idea who the culprit is. Ian demands repayments from Nigel but this is the least of Nigel's problems.
Steve confronts Delia [sic] and she's forced to reveal how she feels about him. Nigel finally decides on a new plan of action.
Nigel is busy with schemes to impress Debbie. Blossom's presence causes friction in the Jackson household. Ricky finds that work pressures are finally getting to him.
Steve is still keen on Della, and Meena turns up on the Square and finds Sanjay is up to his usual tricks.
Della is uncertain what to do about Steve and confides in Binnie. Michelle and Kathy decide it's time for a girls' night out, and Nigel has a close shave.
Michelle finds herself in a dilemma about Geoff.

Delia and Binnie are in trouble with Steve, and Diane has dramatic news for Ricky. David begins to feel his position in the Butcher household is being compromised. Michelle gets herself into an embarrassing situation, and while Mark's away Alan gives the fruit and vegetable stall more of a Caribbean flavour.
Fireworks between Steve and Binnie, Meena and Sanjay cook up a scheme, and Pat receives Frank's last message to her.
Steve continues his search for Della, while Mark catches up with an old flame.

Sharon catches a thief red-handed and Alan receives a worrying letter. Desperate to find Frank, Pat thinks a trip to Clacton will provide her with clues, but is she following her heart or her head? Steve finally receives a message from Delia [sic] but is it what he has been waiting to hear?
Pat, David and Ricky rake up the coals in Clacton while Steve finds his darkest hour is just before dawn.
Blood is spilled at the hairdressing salon, wounds are healed at the Butchers, and debts are settled at Ian's.
Michelle learns her exam results, and Pauline receives news from Carol.
Grant finds out it's more difficult to get through to his brother than he thought. Arthur gets some terrible news.
Phil approaches breaking point. David's plan arouses Ricky's suspicions, while Nigel is once more thwarted by Ian.

Everyone loves a wedding and as Nigel and single mum Debbie prepare to tie the knot, Pauline has plans to turn their reception into anything but the quiet affair they had planned. Best man Grant Mitchell is there to get Nigel to the church on time, but that might not be the end of his duties for the groom - with Debbie's ex-husband Liam still on the scene and out to cause trouble.
It is the big day for Nigel Bates and Debbie Tyler. Nigel is getting ready for the wedding ceremony. But Debbie's abusive first husband Liam Tyler turns up.
Kathy is feeling shattered after recent events but Michelle is on hand to help out.
Phil resorts to desperate measures in his search for Kathy. Arthur is driven to breaking point by Nellie, and Ian travels north on his quest for the truth about Tricky Dicky.
Ian strikes gold when he meets an old acquaintance of Richard's.
David uses his powers of persuasion to secure a backer for Deals on Wheels. Carol has a turnaround in fortune. And Richard's past comes back to haunt him.
Bianca sees Ricky in a new light, David makes Phil an offer he can't refuse, and Carol wonders if money really can buy her love.
Kathy learns some home truths from Pat, Gita shuts Sanjay out, and David and Ricky open for business.
David and Ricky have a disagreement, Sanjay faces up to the mess Tricky Dicky left behind, and Mark says goodbye to an old friend.
Nigel confesses to Debbie, Carol gives Alan a night to remember, and Gita and Mark reach breaking point.
Ricky chooses a new target for his affections, Gita has a confession to make, and Arthur gets some good news.
Della has some news for her mother, and Ricky's time keeping lets him down.
Kathy spends some time away from Phil in order to decide if they have a future together. Arthur takes a trip down memory lane, and Ricky asks Bianca to go out on a date.
Ricky makes Alan an offer, Ian makes an example of Gita, Ruth makes an appearance on the Square, and Pauline is embarrassed when Arthur makes a spectacle of himself.
Ian stirs up trouble between Cindy and Gita, David and Ricky clash over Alan's new job and Phil has a radical change of heart.
Phil and Kathy have made a big decision - at least they think they have; they can't quite remember. Ricky and Bianca meet in secret.
Phil's happiness is jeopardised by Nadia, while Ian feels threatened by his bank manager.
Arthur's birthday brings him mixed blessings, and Phil makes an unwelcome discovery.
Ricky gets Bianca hot under the collar, Gita gets into DIY, and Pauline and Arthur are forced to make a special effort to celebrate Nellie's birthday.

Love is in the air at the Jacksons, while Nellie's in the dumps at the Fowlers. Sanjay finds his mates aren't quite what they seem following a heated discussion in the Queen Vic. Phil receives a visitor with a proposition - but will the offer prove acceptable to him?
Ricky loses his shirt. Pat drops her laundry, and Ian attempts to take Nigel to the cleaners.
Ricky and Bianca have a secret rendezvous, Gita tries to overcome her fears.
Grant thinks it's his lucky day, David blows the whistle on Ricky and Bianca, and Natalie is in for a shock when she makes some new friends.
Pat tells all to a sympathetic Geoff. Ricky and Bianca come up with a plan, and Delia [sic] takes Binnie by surprise.
Cindy is finding it difficult to manage at home, while Mark struggles to cope with his feelings.
Sharon is behaving strangely and Grant can't fathom why. Mark is depressed and Michelle can't seem to comfort him. Cindy is under pressure and Ian can't make time to help her.
Steve encourages Mark to go out on the town. Blossom's plans backfire badly. Pat and Geoff discover things in common.
Ian is forced to pull his weight at home, Natalie joins in Bianca's and Ricky's conspiracy, and Sharon tries to accept Phil and Kathy's engagement.
Cindy is amazed by Ian's change of attitude, Pat suspects she has an admirer, and Sharon visits Phil to lay an old ghost to rest - only to find it is still alive and kicking.
Sparks fly between Sharon and Phil, Michelle starts to worry about Pat and Geoff, and Ian has big news for Cindy.
Sharon and Phil lie for England, Natalie goes looking for friendship in the wrong place and Ian throws himself into a new business venture, but will Cindy be as enthusiastic?
Phil finds that love means having to say you're sorry. Pat has her hands full and David catches a thief.
Pat gets herself an education, Binnie gets herself a new partner and Grant tries to hang onto the one he's got.
Carol has harsh words for David and Alan is in for a nasty shock when he tries to unravel a mystery. Meanwhile, Cindy and Gita consider an afternoon's diversion and Natalie plans a girls' night out.
Cindy and Gita have a fun day out, but Ian's back in the dog-house. Ricky, Bianca and Natalie go out clubbing.
Nigel is worried about the new loan shark and Ricky's had enough of David.
Geoff gives Pat some personal tutoring and Grant gives Phil and Kathy an engagement present.
Sharon and Michelle get together for a girls' night in, and Winston gets a shock when a stranger comes to the Vic.
Bianca tries to get in touch with Ricky while Carol tries to get through to Alan. Sharon and Grant put the past behind them and Michelle puts her foot down with Geoff.
Sharon is shocked to hear about Phil and Kathy's engagement party.
Ricky and Bianca row with their families, and Sharon knuckles down to organising a party for Phil and Kathy. Meanwhile, Grant finds a tape he hasn't heard before.
Pat lets Geoff off the hook, and Bianca can't believe her luck. Steve worries about the salon, and Cindy can't stay away from the swimming pool.
Michelle takes Pauline for a girls' night out, Ian suffers a setback, and Sharon discovers one of Phil's big secrets.
Geoff asks Michelle some awkward questions, Robbie finds a four-legged friend, and David tells Pauline some home truths about Pete.
Cindy goes in at the deep end, Carol sees red over Robbie and Ian's chip shop opening goes with a bang.
Everyone in Albert Square has been invited to celebrate Phil and Kathy's engagement at the Queen Vic. But when Grant gets some devastating news it becomes a party that no one is likely to forget.
Phil and Kathy's party goes off with a bang, underneath the Arches the blood starts to flow, and Sharon realises things can never be the same again.
The party's over and the residents of Albert Square crawl out from the wreckage. And just when every one thinks things can't get worse, they do.
While Phil is still in hospital, Nigel is forced to lie for a friend; Sharon and Michelle find themselves under attack.
Robbie looks to his dad for support when his dog is taken away from him and Cindy looks for a way out of the chip shop. Meanwhile, Phil finds new hope when he is visited by a few friends.
Michelle gets some unwelcome advice at the pub, Ian sees some unsuitable candidates at the chip shop, and Sharon has an unpleasant shock.
Nigel finds himself caught in the crossfire between the Mitchell brothers, and Phil gets an unexpected visit from his mum.
Phil fears he may lose Kathy after all, and Grant makes up his mind about Sharon. Gita has a violent encounter, while David makes a bad mistake in Ricky's absence.
Pat gives Ricky a helping backhander, and Cindy goes to the pool again. Phil's recovery is threatened.
As the doctors operate on Phil, Albert Square watches and waits. Kathy attempts to tell Grant some home truths and Michelle is unable to talk Sharon out of a difficult decision.
"What does a bloke do when he finds his brother's slept with his wife? Forgive him or kill him?" Grant faces his biggest decision yet.
Sharon asks Michelle for one last favour, Cindy drops everything for Matt and Grant has a surprise for Nigel.
With the Mitchells back in business, Sharon has been left out in the cold, Nellie has to face the spectre of her past, and Grant makes a dramatic entrance in the Vic.
Grant and Michelle are at each other's throats, Bianca and Carol compete over Alan's birthday and Pauline plans a trip down memory lane.
Sharon finds herself hosting an impromptu family tea party. Bianca is jealous that Natalie has moved upmarket. Gita takes refuge at Carol's, while Sanjay pounds the streets.
Arthur's hopes for a second honeymoon in Eastbourne are shattered when Nellie plays the tragedy Queen. Sharon's hopes to revive her marriage are crushed when Grant gets the law on his side.
Nellie meets her arch enemy and is forced to face up to an unhappy past. Ruth bites off more than she can chew, and Mark does a spot of DIY.
Nellie makes an important decision, Grant continues to make Sharon's life a misery. Mark gets on the wrong side of Ruth, and Gita gives Sanjay a new sense of direction.
Bianca invites Pat to tea. Nellie has moved in with Jules. Phil tells Kathy he's being discharged from hospital. Cindy visits Matt at the swimming pool and they kiss in the water.
David tells Nellie the Fowlers are glad she's gone. Gita receives anonymous phone call, Phil leaves hospital with Grant and his mum, Bianca wants to meet Natalie's secret boyfriend.
Natalie buys herself a bracelet and tells Bianca it's a present from her boyfriend. Pat isn`t taken in by David, but Nellie is. Sanjay rushes to help Gita from some rowdy youths.
Sanjay is in trouble with the police, Michelle is in trouble with Kathy, and Natalie has a go at Bianca.
Michelle receives her degree, Sanjay receives a complaint, and Cindy nearly gets what she deserves.
Carol struggles to keep her family together. Cindy feels a conflict of interests and David is delighted with a new arrival.
Ricky sets out to impress with a special supper at the bedsit, and Sharon is depressed when Grant hosts a very different kind of party upstairs at the Vic.

Pauline and Arthur are snubbed by Nellie, who plans to spend Christmas with Jules. Cindy uses Gita as an alibi. Pat and Carol are competing to host the Christmas dinner, and Michelle pays a visit to Phil.
Sanjay gets lucky on the horses, Matt gets his revenge on Cindy. David persuades Pat she needs a break. Gita apologises to Sanjay and they decide to spend Christmas together.
The season of goodwill comes to the Square. In among the festivities, Gita has a surprise for Sanjay; Ethel has some advice for Nellie; and Grant has a present for Sharon.

Grant wakes up alone on his and Sharon's third wedding anniversary and takes out his anger on Michelle. Sanjay is disappointed by his new relationship with Gita, and Phil and Kathy find the going is tough.
Sanjay is betting and Debbie wonders if Gita knows. Bianca is bored by Ricky. Pat refuses to go out with Roy Evans. Bianca starts work in the chip shop, and the pub runs out of beer.

Alan gives Ricky and Bianca a television. Ruth is on a high after her job interview at the Community Centre. And Pat comes up trumps for Michelle when she takes over the running of the Vic in Sharon's absence.
Grant makes himself useless at the Vic while Pat juggles her responsibilities. Meanwhile Steve's New Year optimism takes a nose dive when Della gets up to her old tricks.
Pat is busy juggling work commitments and David lets her down. Della gets a shock when Steve looses his tether. Ruth gets good news leaving Michelle feeling inadequate.
An unexpected invitation throws the Jacksons into confusion, while in the Vic, Pat's courage is put to the test, and nosy Nellie learns a few home truths.
Binnie reveals the jealous side of her nature, and Carol discloses a well-guarded secret. Meanwhile, Nellie is making a bid for sympathy, but will Jules take any notice.
Steve takes advantage of the situation when Della and Binnie fall out. Gita talks to Debbie about Sanjay. David is dreaming of the day that Deals On Wheels is a successful business.

Steve takes Della out and makes a serious error of judgement. David tells Pat that the deal with Barry Evans at Manor Wood Motors is about to go through. Natalie develops an interest in car maintenance. Ruth and Mark discuss getting a place of their own.
Nellie has a visit from the council, David tries to put Pat under pressure, and Della tries to put Steve straight.

Carol calls a family conference and decides that honesty is the best policy, Della comes clean to Binnie about her relationship with Steve, Debbie gets involved with Sanjay's gambling exploits and Pauline and Arthur discuss what to do about the 'Nellie situation'.

Celebrations are in order for the Fowler clan when Michelle has some good news to share. Kathy has a bad day in the café when everyone offers her help and advice. Ricky is furious when the Jackson kids prepare for a good time and Bianca and Robbie clash.

Pat finally succumbs to the attentions of car dealer Roy Evans. (but not completely) She takes with her a chaperone, and quite right too, you can't trust a car dealer as far as you can throw him. I mean, look at her own son!  Sanjay learns that when it comes to Gita, honesty is certainly the best policy. Bianca plans the party of the century, Pauline gives Arthur an earful and Steve makes Della an offer she can't refuse.

With Alan and Carol out of the way at Carol's cousin's wedding, Bianca, Ricky and Natalie get ready to party, but wish they had been more selective with their guest list.  Pat is still wary of Roy, but will she heed Kathy's advice? Debbie is surprised by Gita's frankness, while things get busier at the salon much to Della's delight.

Robbie and trusty hound Well'ard face up to the morning after, with news of the Jacksons' party doing the rounds of the Albert Square gossips. Steve gets a futuristic vision involving Kathy, Pat journeys into Roy's past and Arthur has an unpleasant ailment.

At last Michelle has a job, and deservedly so, after all her hard work. She's working for the council and boy, is she excited about her first day. And to round it all off, Geoff plans a surprise for her. Pat decides to keep Roy at arms length, while Bianca shoves Ricky further out of her life when she decides to go out on the town (without him). Binnie takes up an apprenticeship.
Natalie is left out in the cold by Bianca's new friend, whilst Ricky gets taken for a ride.  Arthur thinks Geoff is taking advantage and Steve is promoting the all-night café.

Bianca and Tiffany cause a stir, while Natalie and Ricky have a night to remember when they share their feelings about how Bianca's been treating them. Binnie finds it hard to cope at the salon, but is determined to prove to Della that she can do the job. Mark gets a special birthday gift, and Roy confides in Kathy about his feelings for Pat.
Natalie's walking on air, Bianca's nursing a hangover and Ricky doesn't know where to turn. Steve hopes to impress Tiffany with his glamorous new venture.

Ricky gets in deeper than ever when he tries to get his love life in order. Pauline is feeling guilty about Nellie, so Arthur decides to take drastic measures, while Robbie's new career surprises Carol.
Nellie and Ethel eschew their bus passes and head to the Vic for a girls' night out. Geoff drinks Arthur under the table, and Pauline wonders why. Roy admires Pat's famous hot-pot.

Ricky finds himself caught between two women and agrees to make a choice between them, while Nigel prepares for Valentine's Day with a bulk purchase and a cast-iron idea for making money out of love. Nellie's poorly condition alarms the Fowlers and Debbie gives Sanjay some romantic encouragement.
It may be Valentine's Day, but Carol is annoyed with Alan, Ricky spreads his love too thin and Geoff's romantic dinner gets out of hand.

Ethel's 80th birthday celebrations at the Queen Vic cause some confusion but Pauline and Arthur use the occasion to make peace with Nellie. Pauline is mixed up about Michelle and Bianca catches Ricky in the act.

Kathy and Phil are keen to spend more time with each other, but when she pays him a visit pushy Peggy is there, which is hardly likely to do wonders for anybody's love-life. Ricky is desperate to see Bianca, but when the little madam proves to be evasive, he seeks solace elsewhere. Nigel is devastated to discover that in the eyes of his daughter and her friends, he's not the man he though he was.
Ricky gives Natalie a nasty surprise, Grant advises Nigel on how to be a man and Pat gets a taste of the real Roy.
Natalie says goodbye to the Square, Arthur finds he must drive Nellie to her home, and Nigel stares violence in the face.

Kathy and Phil are making plans for their reunion on his return to Walford but Peggy's intervention doesn't help. Michelle reveals some more of her past to Geoff. Poor Ricky gets laughed at by Mark when he reveals the complexities of his love life.
Michelle wonders if honesty is the best policy, while Kathy decides to show everyone that she's prepared to stand by her man.

A night on the town with Tiffany proves to be memorable for Bianca, although her hopes of finding someone tall, dark and handsome don't turn out quite as she expected. Geoff turns up to see a rather hurt-and-confused Michelle to try and sort things out between them. Ian is frustrated as Steve's new business venture takes off. This time he's getting all hot and bothered trying to persuade Kathy that Steve's all-night café is affecting his business at the fish and chip shop.
Bianca is shocked to find that David is her father. Michelle is surprised by Geoff's marriage proposal. He says he's going away for a few days and gives her 2 weeks to think about it.

When Michelle tells Pauline and Arthur her news she finds her parents' reactions are very different. Peggy decides to make the effort to get to know Kathy better, while Gita wrestles with her conscience over her relationship with Sanjay. As the reverberations of David's revelations shake both the Jackson and Butcher households, Bianca disappears, while her worried mother Carol finds comfort from an unexpected quarter. Arthur is upset at Michelle's news about moving to Scotland.

Michelle and Arthur don't see eye to eye over Geoff's proposal. Michelle's news has hit Arthur hard, but his strong opposition only serves to push her in the other direction with her decision. It looks like Michelle may accept Geoff's proposition. Alan has had enough of David's interest in Bianca. He tries to negotiate some peace between Carol and Bianca, but what he learns leads him to deciding to deal with David in his own way. Peggy's assistance at the Queen Vic is not appreciated by Pat.
Steve comes under financial pressure from an unexpected quarter, while Nigel and Robbie have bunny trouble.

Peggy gives Kathy a makeover, while Phil tests his catering skills. Bianca is feeling decidedly anti-social and Robbie tries to cheer her up by leaving Well'ard with her for company - but will the dog prove a deterrent to an unwelcome caller? Blossom gives Alan a piece of her mind with some strong words of advice which cause him to rethink his plans for the future, and Peggy begins her efforts at transforming Kathy into a new woman.

Ian gets some unwanted business advice from Steve, while Mark confronts his fears about Michelle. Alan tries to get Bianca to bury the hatchet with Carol. Peggy is getting in Pat's way at the Vic and the Kapoors hold a family celebration to mark Sharmilla's second birthday. Meanwhile, a mysterious late-night visitor arrives at Albert Square.
The arrival of a familiar face in the Square surprises the residents, while Carol and Bianca finally face the truth. Michelle is avoiding the issue.
Kathy has a close encounter on the square, Gita makes Sanjay an offer he can't refuse and David tries to set the record straight.
Peggy tries her hand at marriage guidance and Michelle has an answer for Geoff. Gita lays down the law.
While Geoff and Michelle celebrate their engagement, Peggy is determined to get Grant to talk to Sharon, and Bianca has a proposal for David.
Grant faces up to a future without Sharon, while Ruth decides she doesn't want a life without Mark. Nigel gets physical, with disastrous consequences.
Steve's dreams of a business empire begin to crumble. Sanjay finds himself with a score to settle. Della gets itchy feet. Peggy finds out a few family secrets.
Phil gets a late night summons from Peggy, Mark awaits a phone call from Scotland and there's a nasty surprise for Sharon.
Mark invites Arthur and Pauline out for an Indian meal. Sharon pays some surprise visits around the Square. Ricky tries to get Bianca a job at the café.
Blossom is a success at the café. Mark and Ruth take Pauline, Arthur, Michelle and Geoff out and announce their engagement. Alan decides to 'talk things out ' with David about Bianca.
Nigel tries to discuss having a baby with Debbie. Binnie tries to persuade Della to move to Ibiza. Bianca talks David into buying her a car.
Nigel becomes manager of the team. Roy leaves after Pat refuses to go on a cruise with him. Sharon gives Grant a letter from the solicitors.

"Stag night" for Mark in the Vic and Ruth in the Café. Ruth and Pauline find they have something in common, while Tiffany and Bianca find it's a man's world. Sharon is left out in the cold while the rest of the Square enjoy themselves. Mark and Arthur have an emotional talk, and Ruth makes an assurance to Pauline.
Arthur looks forward to full Scottish welcome, but whisky isn't on the menu. Ruth's delighted to become a fully-fledged Fowler, but tempers run high when Mark meets rest of her clan.
The Aitkens are left shell-shocked after the night's revelations, and Mark and Ruth try to pick up the pieces.

It is Michelle, not the bride, who has difficulties in making it to Ruth and Mark's wedding on time.

Arthur, the proud father of the groom, makes his speech at the reception with Pauline proudly by his side while Ruth finds that her "big day" is an occasion for sadness as well as happiness.
Nigel has bad news for Arthur, Michelle is having difficulty living with a honeymoon couple, Grant and Sharon sort things out at the Vic, and Phil visits Ian.

Peggy causes trouble for Della, while Sharon and Michelle's night out takes a nasty turn.

Ricky finds himself with housing problems, and Bianca goes up in the world.
Binnie and Della make travel plans, and Ian is made an offer he can't refuse. Roy tries to say it with flowers, and Michelle decides to go into property.
Grant and Sharon have a brief encounter, Peggy's plans for the Vic suffer a major setback and Alan's pride takes a knock.
Nigel unveils his secret weapon, while Sharon gives the Mitchell's more than they bargained for.
Cindy drops the twins off at nursery on their first day. Ricky makes up with Pat, David gives Bianca a driving lesson. Sharon tells Michelle she is selling up and leaving for good.

The residents of Albert Square celebrate the 50th anniversary of VE Day on Bank Holiday. Arthur intends to make sure it is a day for everybody, young and old alike, to remember.

The market traders enter into the spirit of the occasion but, for Dr Legg and Ethel, it is a time to reminisce about old friends, family and neighbours in Walford during the War years. Meanwhile, Peggy discusses her future with "her boys", Ricky feels lonely and Nigel's day does not go to plan.

The new landlord at the bedsits starts to throw his weight around, and Ricky finds he could be homeless.

Ian gets Cindy just what he's always wanted, and a win for Nigel's football team means another loss for Arthur.

Lydia gets a shock when Della and Binnie write her a reference and Robbie gets a dose of reality when Carol examines his job prospects. Kathy's birthday dinner takes an unexpected turn and Peggy starts planning ahead at the pub. Debbie has second thoughts about confiding in her boss, and David finds he has a house guest when he returns from giving Bianca a driving lesson.
Della and Binnie are promised a last night to remember, but its not quite what they had in mind. Sharon decides to live it up in the Vic, Nigel realises football is a dirty game.
Della and Binnie bid farewell to Albert Square. Peggy makes Sharon an offer she finds she can refuse, and Arthur's day of glory arrives at last, but can he come up to scratch?
It's the longest night of David's life when he takes Bianca on a driving lesson. And Cindy goes looking for a diversion after a night from hell with Ian.
While Nigel is busy making last minute preparations for the final, Debbie gets unwanted attention at work. Cindy finds herself in a state of shock.
Debbie has work worries, Arthur gets his big chance and Grant has a suggestion for Sharon.
Peggy makes plans for the Vic, Grant revives an old acquaintance, and Nigel thinks Debbie is acting strangely. Mark is forced to make some painful admissions.
Kathy plans a family get-together at the Vic, saving Cindy from a close shave with David. Peggy wants to know who Grant's date was.
Debbie gets more than she bargained for when she works late again, while Alan finds it hard to be patient with Bianca.

Sharon and Grant plan another meeting - but Grant has more than business on his mind. Debbie thinks that she might be over-reacting to recent events. Cindy finds her past catching up and threatening to envelop her. Ian tries to get information about Phil from Ricky. David takes Bianca out for another driving lesson.
Arthur enters the political arena, Dougan surprises Debbie, and Bianca and Alan still don't see eye to eye.
Grant and Sharon find themselves having to lie. Ian has a surprise for Cindy and David is hard-pressed to keep up with Bianca's demands.
Mark confesses his worries to Michelle over Ruth. Bianca thinks hard about the meaning of fatherhood, and Debbie finally snaps at Dougan.
Nigel stands up for women's rights, while Grant discovers that the course of true love does not always run smoothly.
Michelle catches Sharon in a compromising position, Ian discovers Phil's dark secret, and Grant finds that being in love means having to say you're sorry frequently.
Peggy gets suspicious about Grant's strange nocturnal behaviour. Ruth and Mark get their wires crossed over the issue of children, and Ian is in trouble with Phil again.
Ian faces up to an angry Phil, while Cindy is flustered by a late night phone call. Debbie recieves an unwelcome visit from Dougan, and Ruth tries to make up with Mark.
Sharon and Peggy conclude their business deal, leaving Grant wondering where he stands. Relations between Mark and Ruth are strained. Tiffany turns up with Bianca at the pub for drink with Ricky.

The police arrive with some devastating news for Nigel.

Phil tries to sweet-talk Kathy, and Tiffany gets a job. Ricky's frank talk throws Bianca, Grant does some secret shopping, and Ian shares his dreams of empire building with a disinterested Cindy.
Albert Square is in a state of shock after Debbie's death. David tries to make plans for Bianca's birthday. Ruth and Mark make plans for a baby. Grant proposes to Sharon.
Sharon keeps Grant hanging on, Peggy celebrates her new regime and David feels a stranger in his own home.

It's a sad day for the residents of Albert Square as they gather to mourn a death and Nigel is troubled when he meets a face from Debbie's past. Sharon makes Grant an offer he may have to refuse. In the Butcher household, David has reached crisis point and needs to find a sympathetic ear.
David finds Bianca too close for comfort, Peggy unveils her plans for the quiz night, and Grant sees a way to meet Sharon's demands.
When Pauline confronts Sharon about her plans, she finds out more than she bargained for. Grant looks for support for the quiz night, while Steve has difficulty finding takers for his holiday.
Grant makes a confession to Nigel, but leaves Phil to speculate about his plans. Sharon takes a last look at the world she grew up in, and the Vic's 1st pub quiz becomes night to remember.
Peggy tries to get an explanation from Grant, Nigel decides he needs legal advice and Pat returns from her holiday to find that everything has changed.
Sanjay wants to go to Spain with Steve and tries to win Gita over. Arthur sets up a snail race for his flowering wilderness campaign. Alan and Carol plan a birthday party for Bianca.

Carol and David disagree over Bianca's birthday party. Grant decides to make up for lost time, while a traumatised Cindy gives David an ultimatum. Arthur gets an enthusiastic response to his Great Snail Race.
Bianca gets ready for a night to remember to celebrate her birthday. Nigel tries to come to terms with Debbie's death and receives an unexpected offer from Arthur.
Competition is hotting up in the Great Snail Race, with Robbie entering a late runner. Kathy lays down the law with Phil, and Roy and Pat confront the past.

Nigel and Clare go to court, but Liam has cleaned up his act and seems set to impress the judge. A desperate Steve manages to find two more takers for his holiday and needs only one more space to be filled.  Arthur upsets Michelle with a tactless remark, while Sanjay encourages Mark to continue with his dodgy game.
David is in for a shock when he boards the plane to Spain, while Steve gets more than he bargained for when he decides to try his luck.
Grant tests his brother's loyalty, David begins a holiday romance and Ricky and Bianca prove how stubborn they can be.

The last night in Spain is a night to remember. Ricky and Bianca dive in head-first, Steve meets his match and Grant faces up to a few home truths. David finds himself listening to a sob story, offering sympathy and comfort.
Bianca hides the truth from Carol and Mark suppresses a guilty secret of his own. Grant and Phil spring a welcome surprise on Peggy.

Sam tries her hand behind the bar - and receives some unexpected attention from Ricky. David turns the tables on Grant and Phil, and Carol has a close shave with the truth. Pat's plan to get a new job is undermined by Roy, while Grant finds a way to boost his income.

Peggy lays down the law to the family, but Pat's warnings to David go unheeded. Quiz Night is a tense occasion when Sam shows up, and Carol is in for a nasty shock of her own. Grant finds a way to boost his income.
Mark's gambling draws him deeper into debt, Alan finds new ways of dealing with David Wicks and Nigel has words with Liam.
Albert Square is out in force for Arthur's `Pubathon'. But although the Jacksons have some good news, the festivities turn sour when it appears that all Arthur's hard work may have been in vain.
Pat comes down hard on Barry and David's dodgy deals. Ruth determines to get to the bottom of Mark's problems and neither Ricky nor David have quite the time for Bianca that she would like.
Grant pulls a fast one but doesn't cover his tracks as well as he thought. Mark is getting into deep water, while Cindy finds she's out of her depth.
Mark cannot face his debts - or Ruth. Kathy is worried by Grant, while Tiffany and Sam find they have more in common than they realised.

Michelle decides to cheer up miserable Mark by taking him out for a night on the town, but later on Mark's bluff is called as he risks everything in a final rash bid. Pat gives David a lesson in parenthood, the police arrive for Grant and Ian pushes his luck with Steve.
Grant gets more than he bargained for when he crosses Tiffany's path, while Pat's plans for the future take an unexpected turn.
Kathy is given some unsolicited advice by Peggy - whether she wants it or not, and Bianca feels her world is falling apart. Pat and Roy don't know if they can pick up the pieces after last night.
Carol and Peggy cross swords, Ricky has an announcement to make, and Kathy has a surprise visitor. Pauline and Arthur make holiday plans.
Grant and Phil's plot against David goes up in smoke, but Entertainment Night at the Vic goes with a bang. Arthur's attempt at public speaking throws Mark and Ruth off course.
The Jacksons have to find a new home while theirs is made safe after a fire next door. Michelle meets her new boss. Arthur's meeting is turned into a riot by troublemakers.
Ricky and David cook a meal for Bianca and Sam respectively but sabotage leads to a four-way row in the café. Michelle tries to arrange housing for the Jacksons. Pauline warns Phil about Ted.
Nigel gets into hot water after agreeing to help Phil and Kathy move house, while Sam comes up with an unlikely present to bring her and David closer together.
Grant becomes out of tune with his surroundings when he and Phil try to move a piano, and David is taken for a ride by Cindy.
Michelle gets a dressing down when she gets emotionally involved at work, Ted is forced into an unexpected admission at Phil and Kathy's dinner party, and Ian decides to call a truce with Arthur.
Kathy plans a fresh start for Ted, and Ricky is offered a new place to live. Cindy gets more than she bargained for when she goes shopping.
Dr Legg has a busy day as a mystery bug sweeps through Albert Square. Phil gets an invitation from Grant but is worried about Kathy's reaction, and Robbie falls in love.

Ruth and Mark wait anxiously for news, while Bianca's family gather around her bedside - with some surprising results. Robbie's lust gets the better of him when he launches himself at the girl of his dreams. Michelle receives some distressing news at work.
Michelle has a surprise at work, while Nigel braves out Debbie's inquest. Robbie looks forward to his first date.
Nigel has an unexpected encounter while David can't resist the lure of the chippy. Tina tries to put as much distance as possible between her and Robbie.
Ricky lends Robbie a sympathetic ear, Gita and Sharmilla wave goodbye to Sanjay, and it seems as if the Jacksons are on the up. But there is more bad news for Michelle.

Kathy is slowly facing up to her situation, but an evening with Pat awakens old memories. Michelle opens the door to an unexpected visitor - and an unexpected offer. Sam loses out to Cindy, while Ian picks up a few tips on telephone technique from David, and nearly blows his cover.
Michelle is thrown off balance by a new proposal from an old flame. Pat goes green when Carol starts talking colour schemes. And David and Cindy are almost caught in the act.

Grant teaches Sam a lesson about her love life, while Kathy wants an opportunity to confide in Ted. David and Ian plan the perfect scam for Quiz Night but with Cindy's help, matters soon get out of hand. Ricky and Alan make a mockery of Pat and Carol's DIY plans.
Sam's plans for revenge on David go badly wrong, while Grant's behaviour is misinterpreted by Ruth with devastating consequences. Cindy and David embark on yet another dangerous liaison.

Passions rise as Michelle confronts Grant in the Vic and the past comes back to haunt them with surprising consequences. Meanwhile, in an attempt to ensure that her future with David is more than a pipe dream, Cindy gets him to face up to some home truths.

Cindy is forced to do some quick thinking, while Michelle has unfinished business with Grant. Arthur has a welcome surprise when he and Pauline return home. Kathy finds that letting Phil in on her little secret could prove harder than she'd imagined.
The past catches up with Ted. Pauline crosses swords with Michelle, while Roy is out for Barry's blood.
Cindy and David are playing with fire. Kathy is at breaking point. Michelle sees a way out.

Bianca gears up for her driving test and a dodgy scheme of David's goes awry. It's a day of surprises for Ian when he gets a shock in the chippy. Michelle has an unwanted visitor who throws her feelings into turmoil.
Kathy can't believe what she has learnt about Ted. Michelle gets a letter and finds her plans for the future thrown wide open.
How will Pauline and Arthur react to Michelle's decision? Kathy wants to see Ted, even if it is only to set the record straight.

Arthur finds himself caught between the stubborn pairing of Pauline and Michelle, while Ted gains a home but loses an old friend. Roy diverts Pat from her decorating. Ian, still obsessed with the Queen Vic quiz night, aims to slaughter the opposition.
Robbie's quiet night in goes wrong. Michelle is forced to think twice about her plans, while Ian prepares for the pub quiz showdown.
Arthur and Mark try to make peace in the Fowler family. Michelle arranges a meeting with an old adversary, while David feels fenced in by Cindy.
Michelle has some peacemaking with Pauline to attend to and some explaining to do to Grant. Michelle's choices will affect the rest of her life, while Arthur decides that Pauline is best left untold.
Arthur finds that he and Mark share a secret, but Pauline is kept in the dark. Gita mixes business with pleasure, Bianca is in the right place at the right time, and Cindy is left out in the cold.
Martin gives Pauline the slip, sparking off a Halloween panic. Sam falls foul of Grant, Tiffany loses her job - and Nigel tries his hand at pulling pints.

Pauline sees her children in a different light, while Arthur receives some threatening post. Nigel can't bring himself to reveal the truth to Clare, and Ian pays Cindy an unwelcome compliment. Tiffany finds she is in a bargaining position with Grant.
Nigel's meeting with his solicitor spells disaster. Grant makes a promise to Clare that he probably can't keep.
Phil tells Grant that he is going to become a father, and Arthur revels in a moment of glory as the Flowering Wilderness Campaign comes to a close.

Arthur has to pass on some unwelcome news about Michelle to Pauline. Alan almost comes to blows with a newcomer to the Square. Robbie and Grant await the birth of Freida's puppies. Nigel puts on a brave face for Clare.
Pauline rounds on Arthur and Mark, Tiffany makes Ricky's life hell, and Nigel gets ready for court.
Nigel and Liam fight for custody of Clare, while Bianca puts Ricky on the spot.

Cindy demands some straight answers from David - and gets more than she bargained for. Kathy and Phil have an announcement to make, but it doesn't quite go according to plan. Mark's concern for Gita's booming business falls on deaf ears. And Nigel starts to plan the rest of his life.
Peggy is delighted about Kathy's pregnancy, but Cindy dreads Ian finding out. Arthur receives congratulations all round as his Flowering Wilderness campaign nears completion.
Arthur and Willy battle with the authorities, Roy offers Pat a solution to both their problems, and Ted teaches Tony a lesson.
Pat has some important news for her family. Peggy's advice is driving Kathy up the wall. Felix is settling into the square. And Cindy gives David her parting shot.

Phil is left holding the babies, with a little help from Grant. Ricky is unsettled by Frank's belongings being moved out and Pat is thrown off balance by an unexpected letter. Meanwhile it's drinks all round as Ted and Roy celebrate their move into the Square.
Ricky leaves for Paris, Well'ard and Sonia share supper, and a troubled Pat goes walkabout. Arthur tries to burn away his worries on a bonfire.

Roy is given a real East End welcome when Pat throws a party to herald his arrival in the Square. Ted is in for a surprise when Sarah shows him how she spent her afternoon. Arthur faces questioning at the police station.

Pauline returns from America to find husband Arthur absent and an unexpected visitor filling his place. As Gita agrees to take things further with Guppy, Robbie attempts to scratch his way to success, much to Sonia's interest.

Things begin to get worse for the Fowlers as a journalist rakes over Arthur's troubles. Robbie discovers the true meaning of Christmas, but misses out on the rewards of his finding, while Nigel's enthusiasm proves costly underneath the Arches. Tiffany is looking for a place to lay her sweet head.

Walford is transfixed by what the papers say. Mark tries to defend the family name, but it's a day of reckoning for Arthur. Robbie tries to recover his losses after a talking-to from Carol, and Nigel makes a quick career change.
A nasty shock awaits Ricky on his return from Paris, Cindy is back with a vengeance and Mark undertakes some private investigations. Pauline wonders if Arthur might be losing his grip.
Roy's in the festive mood, while Pat is haunted by the ghost of Christmas Past. Gita gets ready for her hot date and Mark is on a dangerous mission for justice.

Cindy's playing the perfect wife, at least on the surface. Pauline defends the Fowler name once more, but the family soon receives a shattering blow. Clare and Janine are sure that Felix has something to hide. Kathy wants to know how Pat is coping, while David is surprised by Carol's sensitivity.
Gita finds out Sanjay won't be home for Christmas, Pat allows Kathy to make a call and Pauline goes to court.

Pat can no longer ignore the inevitable and reluctantly receives a visitor. Clare drops in on Felix with disastrous results and Arthur isn't looking forward to Christmas. Felix's acceptance into the Square is by an unusual route. Willy and his mum watch the lottery.

Everyone is embarrassed by Felix's story. Pauline is persuaded to enjoy the Christmas spirit, while Gita's dinner date with Guppy leads to coffee afterwards. Cindy leaves David feeling frustrated, while Steve makes Mark's day.
The Vic is full of Christmas cheer while the Fowlers put on a brave face. Pat’s plans for a perfect Christmas take a dramatic, unexpected turn.
Robbie gets caught eating turkey while Pat confronts ghosts from her past. Pauline gets a distressing call from Arthur in prison.
Kathy is organising Steven's birthday party but has other things on her mind. Pat tries to pick up the pieces but only succeeds in driving people away. She and Pauline cry on each other's shoulder.
